zga_reset_coupling.interpretation: DMRs that re-methylate during ZGA (4-cell->8-cell) tend to demethylate during morula reset (8-cell->morula), rho=-0.439, p<0.001. This ZGA-Reset coupling is the functional link between the upstream erasure branch and the reset-entry branch.

8_element_alignment.B2_cdiag: bidirectional at oocyte->zygote and 4->8; demeth-dominant at zygote->2cell and 2->4cell
8_element_alignment.B3_nonrandomness: ALL pre-8 transitions: top10/25/50 >> random q95
8_element_alignment.B4_module_impulse: M01 dominant across all pre-8; relay to M02/M13/M06 at entry
8_element_alignment.B6_chromatin: RNA coupling not significant; pre-8 chromatin bio weaker than post-8
8_element_alignment.B8_robustness: Interpolation beats baseline for 2/3 left-out stages

new_biological_concept: ZGA-Reset mechanism: ZGA re-methylation (4->8) predicts morula reset demethylation (8->morula)
